unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Cumulative PCIe hardware byte counters remain unknown: they require a successful collector-specific probe; topology, the observed SHM/direct/direct NCCL channels, and logical payload (497759232 bytes/rank) do not measure traffic. Only NVML pcie.tx/pcie.rx rates are observable, from ~20 ms driver-aligned windows not aligned to operator ranges
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Counter-based hardware utilization is unknown: it requires a successful collector-specific probe; NVML device.gpu_utilization is a device-dependent sampling ratio whose window is not aligned to operator ranges and is not a hardware-counter measurement

plan.rationale: torch already ran and stays the attribution baseline for the frozen objective (minimize step_ms and diagnostic.max_rank_nccl_kernel_sum_ms under the 1.05x baseline step-time constraint): 13/13 allreduces matched cross-rank, zero unmatched communication kernels, payload coverage 13/13, and exact bucket links established by native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership with matched parameter inventory (12 buckets x 28351488 B plus the final 157541376 B bucket = 497759232 logical B/rank; logical payload is not wire traffic). It supplies the rank kernel sums that motivate the diagnosis: 279.904 ms on rank 0 vs 63.789 ms on rank 1. nsys is selected because it is available and the evidence leaves open exactly the overlap, graph-tracing and attribution questions timelines resolve: communication_without_compute_ms is 272.782 ms on rank 0 vs 56.339 ms on rank 1, the first collective kernel spans 89.678 ms vs 3.561 ms, and 208 of the forward sequences over 4004 associated kernels remain ambiguous. Nsys analysis stays within each rank's trace clock (no cross-rank timestamp subtraction per the observed clock policy), and nsys timelines alone will not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer nor re-prove bucket identity; bucket identity remains with the torch-observed gradient-storage membership, and ambiguous candidates would be retained only where that membership is absent. device_telemetry is selected for workload-window NVML sampling of pcie.tx, pcie.rx and device.gpu_utilization: with peer_access.0.1 and peer_access.1.0 both observed 0 and NCCL channels on SHM/direct/direct, these rates are the only actually observed traffic and occupancy signals, sampled in ~20 ms driver windows not aligned to operator ranges, and are never inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes. nvlink_bytes, pcie_bytes and hardware_utilization are listed unavailable with their observed probe reasons. ncu is not selected: it is not among the available collectors and kernel replay would perturb the frozen timing without adding overlap, attribution or coarse-traffic evidence.
